title: Your first trade for Friday, January 4
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.

Tim Seymour was a buyer of Activision Blizzard .
Dan Nathan was a buyer of Expedia .
Guy Adami was a buyer of Newmont Mining Corporation .
